rules.description: Texas: no statewide sick leave requirement for private employers

source.title: Texas Workforce Commission — Texas Guidebook for Employers: Vacation, Sick, and Parental Leave Policies

versions.notes: TWC: sick and/or parental leave is not required unless it would be a reasonable accommodation under disability- or pregnancy-related laws.

rules.description: Texas minimum wage (Texas Minimum Wage Act adopts the federal FLSA rate)

source.title: U.S. DOL WHD — State Minimum Wage Laws (updated 1 July 2026)

versions.notes: Long-standing rule; in force before this date. Earlier history is not modelled — effectiveFrom is the modelling baseline, not the date the rule was enacted. Texas Labor Code ch. 62 adopts the FLSA section 6 rate by reference.

rules.description: Texas notification of breach of security (Bus. & Com. Code 521.053)

individuals.standard: without unreasonable delay and in each case not later than the 60th day after the date on which the person determines that the breach occurred

regulator.standard: as soon as practicable and not later than the 30th day after the date on which the person determines that the breach occurred, submitted electronically

consumerReportingAgencies.standard: without unreasonable delay, when more than 10,000 persons are notified at one time

source.title: Texas Business and Commerce Code section 521.053

versions.notes: 521.053(b) individuals within 60 days of determination; (c) a person maintaining data it does not own notifies the owner 'immediately after discovering the breach'; (h) consumer reporting agencies over 10,000; (i) Attorney General 'not later than the 30th day' if at least 250 Texas residents. effectiveFrom = 1 September 2023, from which the Attorney General requires electronic reports (https://www.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumer-protection/data-breach-reporting); earlier versions not modelled.

coverage.notes: No statewide paid sick leave. City paid sick leave ordinances (Austin, Dallas, San Antonio) — legal status not verified; not modelled. No daily overtime.
